title: Monthly evil report
subtitle: {{month}} at a glance
exportStarted: Your report is being prepared. We'll email it when the printer stops smoking.
emptyBody: No schemes ran in this period. Suspiciously quiet, even for you.
turnoverTooltip: Minions who left, quit or were launched out of the lair this month. Henchmen are counted separately, because they insist on it and HR has stopped arguing.
quarterlySummary: This quarter you threatened more cities than ever and collected record ransom. Unfortunately, heroes foiled four out of five schemes, mostly on Tuesdays. Consider moving the weather machine launch to a weekend and giving the henchmen fewer keys.
quarterlyOutlook: Next quarter's forecast assumes no new heroes move into the area. If one does, every number on this page becomes optimistic. Plan for at least one, and budget accordingly.
